spacezero.notes: Declined 2026-11-05: an X11/GTK game, not a terminal one.

conquest-jtrulson.notes: Declined 2026-11-05: a client/server multiplayer game that needs a running Conquest server.

0verkill.notes: Declined 2026-11-05: client/server over UDP; even a local game needs a separate server process, and games can't start programs.

cataclysm-dark-days-ahead.notes: Declined 2026-11-05: far too large for the APK (hundreds of MB of data in recent versions; Ubuntu's 0.G source alone is huge).

solar-system-explorer.notes: Declined 2026-11-05: our solar system is loaded from an online API (api.le-systeme-solaire.net) with a baked-in key; offline it only has other star systems.

gittype.notes: Declined 2026-11-05: typing practice on your own code repositories, which a phone game home doesn't have; its repository is 141 MB.

terminal-space-program.notes: Deferred 2026-11-05: requires Go 1.26; the build pins Go 1.24.7. Port once the toolchain moves to 1.26.

rebels-in-the-sky.notes: Deferred 2026-11-05: a large Rust game built around peer-to-peer online play (libp2p); an offline build needs checking.

chess-tui.notes: Deferred 2026-11-05: the bot needs an external engine (games can't start programs) and online play needs a network mode; a two-players-on-one-phone build is possible.

dungeon-crawl-stone-soup.notes: Deferred 2026-11-05: in Ubuntu (crawl 0.28.0); a large C++ port (bundled Lua and sqlite, ~30 MB of data). Worth doing as its own project.

myman.notes: Deferred 2026-11-05: source reachable on SourceForge (myman-wip-2009-10-30); its multi-variant build needs its own port session. Check the licence (BSD-style per the author).

frotz.notes: Deferred 2026-11-05: in Ubuntu (frotz 2.54); needs freely redistributable Z-code stories to bundle, since players can't add files.
